text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: 50% of model fetches (hf.co artifacts) are failing with 429/503 during our prefetch window. Increased cold-start rates observed. Paging on-call.
kevin-sre: on it — pinging infra and hf-status. any customer-visible errors yet? could be prefetch throttling or auth.
anya-ml: noticing spike in cold starts for small_batch workloads in us-west1, latency + tail tokens up ~3x.
samar-frontend: a couple of internal dashboards show 5xxs when trying to load embeddings endpoints; customers may see degraded responses.
lisa-cs: CS is getting one alert from a mid-market customer about timeouts in a ingestion job. tagging: @maria-ops for customer impact assessment.
maria-ops: acknowledged, pulling request traces, will update in a few.
hf-status-bot: HF API status: "Rate limiting detected on model artifact downloads in region us-west-1" — https://status.huggingface.co (last update 2m ago)
kevin-sre: ok looks like HF is rate-limiting artifact pulls. immediate mitigation ideas: 1) enable cached mirror for hot models (GCS/our mirror) 2) switch runtime to pre-provisioned local cache 3) temporary fallback to smaller model variant. any objections?
anya-ml: agree. also we should disable aggressive prefetching for workflows hitting failures — that reduces pressure.
samar-frontend: how do we flip mirror? Is there a feature flag or infra route?
devops-runbook-bot: Runbook excerpt: \n```
Mitigation: model-fetch-rate-limit
1) toggle feature: `prefetch.enabled=false` for affected pool
2) enable mirror: `model_fetch.mirror=gcs://redwood-hf-cache`\n3) set fallback model alias: `model_alias: guppy-small`\n4) warm local cache: `curl -X POST /admin/cache/warm?model=guppy-small`\n```
kevin-sre: I can flip `prefetch.enabled` to false for the prefetcher in us-west now. doing it.
kevin-sre: done. prefetch paused. will monitor fetch error rate.
anya-ml: reducing prefetch drops HF error rate from 50% -> 28% in logs. still high but improving.
lisa-cs: telling the affected customer we’re investigating and implementing mitigations, ETA 15m for initial fix.
maria-ops: customer impacted: acct-acme-inc — ingestion job retries hit 120s timeout. CS notified, offering workaround: reduce parallel workers.
hf-status-bot: HF update: "We are applying rate-limit relief for artifact downloads. Waiting for stabilization." (link)
kevin-sre: starting mirror enable: creating mirror job to pull hot model versions to GCS buckets. kicked off: job id job-9998
devops-runbook-bot: Mirror job started: logs available at https://internal-logs/redwood/jobs/job-9998
kevin-sre: triggered warmup of local cache for most-used model: `POST /admin/cache/warm?model=base-alpha-1` — warmup OK for 3/4 nodes, one node 504 from HF while pulling.
anya-ml: for the node that 504'd, I'm starting an on-node re-fetch from mirror bucket instead of HF.
samar-frontend: routing tweak to direct new cold-starts to nodes that warmed successfully? can we do that temporarily?
kevin-sre: yes — setting routing weight: `route:model=base-alpha-1 -> node-group=warmers (100%)` for the next 10m
lisa-cs: CS update to acct-acme-inc: "We've paused prefetching and are serving from warmed nodes; small chance of degraded tail latency while mirroring completes. We're monitoring closely."
maria-ops: customer confirmed reduced errors after adjusting workers. good.
hf-status-bot: HF: "Artifact download rate limiting easing; monitoring. Some customers may see transient failures." (timestamped)
kevin-sre: error rate now ~6% for fetches — still occasional 429 spikes. leaving prefetch off until HF confirms stable. continuing mirror pulls.
anya-ml: moving some production traffic to guppy-small alias for non-critical paths to avoid further cold starts until mirror fully populated.
kevin-sre: raising follow-up ticket to infra: persist warmed cache across node restarts and add exponential backoff to prefetcher. ticket INFRA-4242
devops-runbook-bot: Created INFRA ticket INFRA-4242: Persist local model cache, add prefetch backoff. assignee: maria-ops.
maria-ops: taking INFRA-4242.
lisa-cs: CS will send postmortem note to affected customers summarizing actions and ETA for full restoration once HF confirms.
kevin-sre: oncall handoff in 40m; I'll document state in incident doc. current status: partial mitigation via mirror + prefetch disabled, customer workaround applied. next: continue mirror, wait HF final word.
incident-bot: Pager duty: scheduled handoff to @kevin-sre -> @maria-ops at 2051234880. Please acknowledge.
maria-ops: acknowledged, will take over at handoff.
kevin-sre: leaving logs + commands in the incident doc: https://go/internal/incidents/2051234567
anya-ml: quick note: consider adding HF artifact CDN mirrors as a first-class cache target in deployment config.
kevin-sre: agreed. follow-up in INFRA-4242. thanks all :thumbsup:
lisa-cs: closing check: customers on retention list notified. will keep channel updated if HF flips to fully resolved.
hf-status-bot: HF status now: "Service operating normally" — monitoring for anomalies.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations in place; customer impact reduced. moving to monitoring state. will convert to postmortem thread for root cause + remediation.
